scripts.build:foundation: npm run build -w @vetready/contracts && npm run build -w @vetready/domain && npm run build -w @vetready/api
scripts.build: npm run build:foundation && npm run build -w @vetready/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:foundation && npm run typecheck -w @vetready/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.local/database.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:foundation && vitest run tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.local/database.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/integration tests/e2e
